name: filter-polish-50d9bf4e
description: Полировка, часть 5 (ошибка 50d9bf4e), п. A8 + C2/C3. A8: онбординг → карта → «Изменить отбор» типа мысли → в диалоге отбора набиваем дерево условий и численно проверяем геометрию: высота диалога = min(1360px, 94vh) (роль l 680px → вдвое = 1360px), прокручивается ТОЛЬКО дерево (`.fe > .ft`), а имя/описание/представление отбора (`.ff-name`, `.fe-foot`) вне прокрутки; затем окно растягивается — диалог обязан дорасти до 1360. C2/C3: экран «События», операнд «Тип действия», оператор «в» → поле множественных значений (чипы + «Выбрать значения…»), в выпадающем чеклисте 2 колонки и «Выбрать все»; при серии переключений панель обязана следовать за якорем (не оставаться на старых координатах). Запуск: node client/scripts/ui-probe-stand.mjs --scenario client/scripts/ui-probe.filter-polish-50d9bf4e.scenario.json

steps.name: seed-type
steps.eval: (async () => { const nid='{{networkId}}'; const type=await window.etn.types.createThoughtType(nid, { name: 'Тип стенда A8' }); const cur=await window.etn.thoughts.get(nid, '{{homeId}}'); await window.etn.thoughts.update(nid, '{{homeId}}', { type_id: type.id }, cur.version); window.__a8 = { typeId: type.id, viewId: null }; return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: focus-home
steps.eval: (async () => { const el=document.querySelector('[data-id="{{homeId}}"] .cloud') || document.querySelector('.canvas-focus-row .cloud'); if(!el) return 'no-cloud'; el.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{bubbles:true,cancelable:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: add-enabled
steps.waitFor: (() => { const b=document.querySelector('.canvas-filter-strip-add'); return b !== null && b.disabled === false; })()

steps.name: seed-view
steps.eval: (async () => { const nid='{{networkId}}'; const def=JSON.stringify({ version: 1, filter: { entity: { kind: 'id' }, operator: 'eq', value: '{{thoughtId}}' } }); const v=await window.etn.thoughtTypeViews.create(nid, window.__a8.typeId, { name: 'Отбор стенда A8', definition: def }); window.__a8.viewId=v.id; return v.id ? 'ok' : 'no'; })()

steps.name: view-button
steps.waitFor: (() => { const b=document.querySelector('.canvas-filter-strip-btn[data-view-id="'+window.__a8.viewId+'"]'); return b !== null && b.disabled === false; })()

steps.name: click-edit
steps.eval: (() => { const it=[...document.querySelectorAll('.menu-item')].find(e=>(e.textContent||'').includes('Изменить отбор')); if(!it) return 'no-item'; it.click(); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: grow-tree-1
steps.eval: (async () => { for (let i=0;i<10;i+=1) { const b=document.querySelector('.view-editor-body .ft-add-condition'); if(!b) return 'no-btn'; b.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,40)); } return document.querySelectorAll('.view-editor-body .ft-row').length; })()

steps.name: grow-tree-2
steps.eval: (async () => { for (let i=0;i<10;i+=1) { const b=document.querySelector('.view-editor-body .ft-add-condition'); if(!b) return 'no-btn'; b.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,40)); } return document.querySelectorAll('.view-editor-body .ft-row').length; })()

steps.name: a8-measure-base
steps.eval: (() => { const box=document.querySelector('.dialog-box.view-editor-dialog') || document.querySelector('.view-editor-body').closest('.dialog-box'); if(!box) return 'no-dialog'; const body=document.querySelector('.view-editor-body'); const tree=body.querySelector('.fe > .ft'); const foot=body.querySelector('.fe-foot'); const nameRow=body.querySelector('.ff-name'); const preview=foot ? foot.querySelector('.ff-preview') : null; const rect=(e)=>e?e.getBoundingClientRect():null; window.__a8Base={ viewportH: window.innerHeight, dialogH: box.offsetHeight, dialogRole: box.dataset.dialogSize, treeClient: tree.clientHeight, treeOverflow: tree.scrollHeight-tree.clientHeight, footClient: foot.clientHeight, footOverflow: foot.scrollHeight-foot.clientHeight, bodyOverflow: body.scrollHeight-body.clientHeight, nameInTree: tree.contains(nameRow), previewInTree: tree.contains(preview), previewInFoot: foot ? foot.contains(preview) : null, nameTop: rect(nameRow)?Math.round(rect(nameRow).top):null, treeTop: Math.round(rect(tree).top), treeBottom: Math.round(rect(tree).bottom), previewTop: rect(preview)?Math.round(rect(preview).top):null, footTop: Math.round(rect(foot).top) }; return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(window.__a8Base)); })()

steps.name: a8-representation-outside-scroll
steps.probe: window.__a8Base.previewInTree === false && window.__a8Base.previewInFoot === true && window.__a8Base.previewTop >= window.__a8Base.treeBottom - 1

steps.name: a8-resize-tall
steps.eval: (async () => { window.resizeTo(1600, 1600); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,600)); return window.innerHeight; })()

steps.name: a8-measure-tall
steps.eval: (() => { const box=document.querySelector('.dialog-box.view-editor-dialog'); if(!box) return 'no-dialog'; window.__a8Tall={ viewportH: window.innerHeight, dialogH: box.offsetHeight, roleL: 680, ratioToRoleL: Math.round(box.offsetHeight/680*100)/100, doubled: box.offsetHeight >= 1360 - 8 }; return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(window.__a8Tall)); })()

steps.name: a8-close-dismiss
steps.eval: (() => { const backs=[...document.querySelectorAll('.dialog-backdrop')]; const top=backs[backs.length-1]; if(!top) return 'no-dialog'; const labels=['Не сохранять','Отмена','ОК','Да']; for (const l of labels) { const b=[...top.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x=>x.textContent.trim()===l); if(b){ b.click(); return l; } } return 'no-btn'; })()

steps.name: c23-measure-1
steps.eval: (() => { const pop=document.querySelector('.ui-popover.ui-chip-checklist-popover'); const add=document.querySelector('.activity-filter .fv-enum .ui-chip-list-add--checklist'); if(!pop||!add) return 'no-element'; const pr=pop.getBoundingClientRect(); const ar=add.getBoundingClientRect(); window.__c23Anchor = add; window.__c23={ popTop: Math.round(pr.top), popLeft: Math.round(pr.left), addTop: Math.round(ar.top), addBottom: Math.round(ar.bottom), addLeft: Math.round(ar.left), anchorConnected: add.isConnected, chips: document.querySelectorAll('.activity-filter .fv-enum .ui-chip').length, checkboxes: document.querySelectorAll('.ui-popover.ui-chip-checklist-popover .ui-choice-row input').length }; return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(window.__c23)); })()

steps.name: c23-measure-2
steps.eval: (() => { const pop=document.querySelector('.ui-popover.ui-chip-checklist-popover'); const add=document.querySelector('.activity-filter .fv-enum .ui-chip-list-add--checklist'); window.__c23After={ popPresent: pop !== null, popTop: pop?Math.round(pop.getBoundingClientRect().top):null, addTop: add?Math.round(add.getBoundingClientRect().top):null, addBottom: add?Math.round(add.getBoundingClientRect().bottom):null, gapToAnchor: (pop&&add)?Math.round(pop.getBoundingClientRect().top-add.getBoundingClientRect().bottom):null, anchorReplaced: add !== window.__c23Anchor, anchorDetached: !window.__c23Anchor.isConnected, chips: document.querySelectorAll('.activity-filter .fv-enum .ui-chip').length, checked: [...document.querySelectorAll('.ui-popover.ui-chip-checklist-popover .ui-choice-row input')].filter(i=>i.checked).length }; return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(window.__c23After)); })()
